source: Dogfood-derived snapshot from llm-wiki Session Memory on 2026-06-17.

memories.title: Worker reconciliation skips stale ops from inactive context memories
memories.summary: Ingest worker reconciliation should still fail on references outside the supplied reconciliation context, but it now skips supersession/retraction operations when a memory was valid in context and became inactive before apply time. The fix was verified with `rtk bun test` and `rtk git diff --check`.

memories.title: Finish llm-wiki dogfood ingest and inspect reconciliation
memories.summary: Continue the current `llm-wiki` ingest run to completion, then index session memories and inspect active/superseded memories plus links so the branch-aware reconciliation path can be verified end to end.

memories.title: Git context is stored with session memories
memories.summary: Experience events now persist `repo_path`, `git_branch`, `git_commit`, and `git_worktree_id`, session memories get matching context rows, and session memory queries can filter by git branch while hydrating those contexts.

memories.title: Lease-backed ingest runtime is implemented and validated
memories.summary: The ingest-runtime stabilization work is now implemented on `master`: workers create tombstone-backed lease stubs, keep source rows until terminal commit, support stale lease recovery, expose configurable worker concurrency, delay, timeout, prompt budget, and ingest model settings, and add project-level status readback with completion-layer counts.

memories.title: Ingest-runtime stabilization design is finalized
memories.summary: The finalized design for ingest-runtime stabilization uses tombstone-backed lease stubs for traceability and duplicate prevention, reuses the same stub on retry, keeps status layered with a numeric enum, moves ingest runtime controls into a named `myelin.config` profile, stores failures as compact typed metadata plus log references, and prefers a small real retest plus a bounded replay fixture.

memories.title: Relational ingest works
memories.summary: Myelin now has a working relational ingest pipeline: it claims Experience Log rows, runs a detached Codex-backed worker, validates structured JSON output, writes session memories/candidates/handoffs, and finalizes tombstones.

memories.title: llm-wiki is the actual dogfood project key
memories.summary: This repo is already bootstrapped as `llm-wiki`; `bun src/cli.ts ingest status --project myelin` was misleading until the project-key validation fix, so `myelin` should be treated as unknown unless a deliberate rename migration is added.

memories.title: Prefer inline for small fixes
memories.summary: For small, local, deterministic fixes, ask before creating Symphony tasks and prefer fixing inline in the same turn. Reserve Symphony for medium-sized, ambiguous, cross-cutting, or independently reviewable work.

memories.title: CLI docs are centralized in docs/CLI.md
memories.summary: `docs/CLI.md` is now the exhaustive command reference, linked from `README.md` and `docs/README.md`, so command usage, options, side effects, and examples live in one canonical place.

memories.title: Ingest jobs now have list and resolve admin commands
memories.summary: The CLI now exposes `ingest jobs` for investigation and `ingest jobs resolve` for environment cleanup; resolving a failed job marks it completed, clears `error_json`, and preserves the prior error in `followup_state_json`, while `ingest status` now fails fast for unknown project keys.

memories.title: Ingest no longer hard-fails non-master branches
memories.summary: Ingest now records the target branch in job metadata and followup state instead of rejecting non-master branches, so branch context is preserved while detached workers still run.

memories.title: Session Memory retrieval is live after indexing
memories.summary: After `memory index session wizepal`, query retrieval returns stored memories instead of an empty result, so the earlier retrieval pending blocker is obsolete.

candidates.title: Query architecture shape is still unsettled
candidates.summary: The query subsystem has conflicting guidance: the current slice favors compositional services and plain data objects, but the longer-term shape may want explicit service/layer objects with injected dependencies for future polymorphic retrieval layers.
candidates.reason: The source includes conflicting design advice, so this should be reviewed before hardening the query layer boundary.
